text: You’re awake! Good. I was going to carry you, but I’m more of a leader than a lifter.
Don’t sit up too fast. The train came down, and everyone walked away from it. Even the train, nearly.
Do you remember your name? No? Don’t worry. Mine came to me in a dream. It was “Chosen”.
Just before we hit, there was a square of light on the rails ahead. Square. Nobody else saw it.
I saw it. I see everything. Right now I see that we need a plan.
The cargo held three Billies. Every hero needs a companion. Not me, obviously. You.
Three Billies, three types. Each one beats one of the others. Choose wisely. Like I would.
Emberox! Bold. I’d have picked that one too. I didn’t. But I would have.
The cargo had five pyramids and a potion too. Take them. A tired wild Billie is easier to keep.
The station’s rescue beacon is at the far end of this valley. The arrows at the edge point the way.
We’ll guard the wreck. Bravely. From here.
